messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: 5xx/error spike and user complaints for model variant 'v2f' observed in us-west-2. Error rate 9.8% (baseline 0.7%). Trigger: anomaly-detector/edge.
Mia (oncall): seeing this, paging Raj and Elena. I'm taking initial triage.
Mia (oncall): Nate, any customer-facing reports?
Nate (support): yes — 3 distinct customers filed tickets about corrupt JSON outputs and inexplicable tokenization truncation, started ~09:42 UTC. I pasted one sample in #support-private.
Raj (eng-sre): pulling metrics and traces now. Correlation looks strong to inference runtime errors when v2f served sequences >1024 tokens.
Elena (eng-runtime): odd — v2f was validated for 2048. I'll check kernel/quant path.
Mia (oncall): mitigation options: 1) throttle v2f (reduce traffic), 2) route traffic to v2-stable, 3) disable v2f variant entirely. Which is fastest?
Raj (eng-sre): quickest is to route new requests to v2-stable and set v2f weight to 0. We'll avoid full infra deploy.
Elena (eng-runtime): agree. I can issue a live traffic update. We'll also add a request-level rate limit for customers who heavily hit v2f until we validate.
Mia (oncall): assign me to run the traffic change with Elena supervising. Raj, can you prepare rollback steps if the route change causes other regressions?
Raj (eng-sre): on it. I'll prep commands and watch dashboards.
Elena (eng-runtime): executing now. Command:```bash
# shift 100% of route 'text-gen' from v2f to v2-stable
redwoodctl route update --route text-gen --model v2-stable --weight 100
# set variant v2f weight to 0 to stop new traffic
redwoodctl model variant set-weight --model rwd-v2 --variant v2f --weight 0
```
Elena (eng-runtime): running first command.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: change submitted: route/text-gen -> v2-stable (100%) by elena. Job id: jb-48293.
Elena (eng-runtime): command returned ok. Now setting v2f weight to 0.```bash
redwoodctl model variant set-weight --model rwd-v2 --variant v2f --weight 0 --reason "emergency mitigation: high error rate"
```
Elena (eng-runtime): weight set to 0. Propagating across regions (us-west-2, us-east-1).
Raj (eng-sre): seeing traffic shift on dashboards, error rate for text-gen request path dropping already to 1.2% in us-west-2. Latency stable.
Mia (oncall): Nate — please notify affected customers that we routed them to a safer variant and we're investigating root cause. Use standard incident template and include ETA for follow-up.
Nate (support): sending notifications now. Will use incident id INC-4820 and link to thread.
Zoe (product): any known quality delta to call out? v2-stable is slightly more conservative on hallucinations but higher cost per token. Need to flag for billing/reporting.
Mia (oncall): acknowledged — Zoe please coordinate with finance on impact. We'll document.
Elena (eng-runtime): quick health check: running a few long-sequence eval prompts against v2-stable and v2f (local replica) — v2-stable returns clean, v2f shows tokenization out-of-bounds errors in runtime logs: `kv_cache_index_out_of_range` at step ~1300 for some sharded kernels.
Raj (eng-sre): captured kernel backtraces and core dumps (sanitized) and uploaded to /artifacts/inc-4820.
Mia (oncall): handoff: I'm going to step off at 10:30 UTC — Raj, you're primary now. Please continue watch and coordinate with Elena for root cause and fix. I'll be reachable for escalation.
Raj (eng-sre): taking over. Set on-call note in PagerDuty.
Mia (oncall): thanks — marking this as mitigated for customer impact (no new requests hit v2f). Need follow-up: postmortem, telemetry probe to detect kv cache index anomalies earlier, and add a canary job for sequence lengths >1500.
Elena (eng-runtime): agree on probes and canary. Also will open a PR to force strict bounds checks in the kernel executor.
Nate (support): customers acknowledged mitigation, most pleased with quick response. Two customers asked for timeline to resume v2f — we should avoid definite ETA until root cause fixed and canary passes.
Zoe (product): also recommend flagging any usage metrics for v2f in billing exports so customers can see they've been routed to v2-stable. I'll prepare comms template.
Raj (eng-sre): current plan: (a) keep v2f weight 0, (b) reproduce in a debug harness, (c) patch kernel bounds checks, (d) run extended canary 48h, (e) re-enable with gradual traffic if green. I'll draft runbook items.
Mia (oncall): excellent. Closing initial incident signal — status: mitigation applied, customer routing fixed. Opening incident ticket INC-4820 (P1 -> P2 pending RCA).
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: INC-4820 status -> mitigated. Handed to oncall Raj.
Raj (eng-sre): leaving a note: please add any logs/samples you have to the ticket. Follow-up sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC for postmortem owners (Elena, Raj, Zoe, Nate).
Elena (eng-runtime): will run local reproducer and attach artifacts.
Mia (oncall): thanks team — big props for quick triage :thumbsup: 
Nate (support): closing customer-facing updates. Will reopen if they report further issues.
Raj (eng-sre): monitoring continues. If anyone sees spike reappearance, ping me directly.
Elena (eng-runtime): creating PR link: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pulls/2319 (kernel bounds check).
inc-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: incident state -> monitoring (post-mitigation)."
